Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Harvest

A Bastion can have more than one Garden. Each time you add one, choose its type on the Garden Types table. While in your Bastion, you can have the hireling change its type; the work takes 21 days, during which the facility does nothing else.

Harvest: Garden Growth. The hireling collects the harvest of the Garden shown on the table. The work takes 7 days and costs nothing.

Enlarging the Facility. For 2,000 GP, your Garden becomes Vast: it counts as two Roomy Gardens of the same or different types, each producing its own harvest, and it gains one more hireling.

Garden TypeDescriptionHarvest
DecorativeFlowers and topiaries pleasing to the eyeTen exquisite floral bouquets (5 GP each), ten vials of Perfume, or ten Candles
FoodDelicious mushrooms or vegetables100 days of Rations
HerbRare herbs, some of them medicinalHerbs to make ten Healer's Kits or one Potion of Healing
PoisonPlants and fungi yielding poisons and antitoxinsPlants to make two vials of Antitoxin or one vial of Basic Poison
